label: Taxation
definition: Levies and taxes imposed by government authorities

label: Consumption Taxes
definition: Taxes on the purchase and consumption of goods and services

label: Value Added / Goods & Services Tax
definition: Multi-stage consumption tax with input tax credit mechanism across supply chain

label: Retail Sales Tax
definition: Single-stage retail consumption tax collected at final point of sale without input credits

label: Central Goods and Services Tax
definition: Intra-state GST component levied by the Central Government of India

label: State Goods and Services Tax
definition: Intra-state GST component levied by State Governments in India

label: Integrated Goods and Services Tax
definition: Inter-state GST levied on supply of goods/services and imports into India

label: Union Territory Goods and Services Tax
definition: GST levied in Union Territories of India without state legislature

label: GST Compensation Cess
definition: Cess levied on specified luxury and demerit goods under GST

label: Input Tax Credit (ITC)
definition: Credit allowed for tax paid on inputs against tax payable on output supplies

label: Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
definition: Liability to pay tax shifts from supplier to recipient of goods/services

label: Income Taxes
definition: Direct taxes levied on financial income or profits of entities and individuals

label: Corporate Income Tax
definition: Direct tax on profits earned by companies and corporate bodies

label: Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT / AMT)
definition: Minimum corporate tax threshold calculated on book profits

label: Withholding Tax / Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
definition: Tax withheld by payer at the source of payment and remitted directly to the government

label: Tax Collected at Source (TCS)
definition: Tax collected by seller from buyer at the time of sale of specified goods

label: Capital Gains Tax
definition: Tax on profit realized on the sale of a non-inventory asset / investment

label: Dividend Distribution / Withholding Tax
definition: Tax levied on dividend payments made to shareholders

label: Personal Income Tax
definition: Tax levied on personal earnings and wages of individuals

label: Payroll & Social Security Tax
definition: Taxes paid by employers and employees calculated on wages or salaries

label: Customs & Import Duties
definition: Taxes and tariffs levied on goods entering or leaving national borders

label: Excise Duty
definition: Inland tax on sale or production for sale of specific goods (e.g. petroleum, tobacco)

label: Stamp Duty
definition: Tax on legal documents usually involving the transfer of real estate or financial assets

label: Property & Real Estate Tax
definition: Ad valorem tax levied on the assessed value of real property

label: Transfer Pricing Adjustment
definition: Tax adjustments regarding arm's-length pricing of cross-border intercompany transactions

label: Deferred Tax Asset
definition: Asset on balance sheet reflecting tax overpayments or carryforward benefits

label: Deferred Tax Liability
definition: Liability reflecting income taxes payable in future periods for taxable temporary differences

label: Financial Statements
definition: Canonical line items from financial statements under IFRS, US GAAP, and Ind AS

label: Income Statement / Statement of Profit and Loss
definition: Financial statement reporting revenues, expenses, and net profit over a period

label: Revenue / Turnover
definition: Total amount of income generated by sales of goods or services from core operations

label: Other Operating & Non-Operating Income
definition: Income derived from activities not related to core business operations

label: Total Revenue / Income
definition: Sum of core operational revenue and other income

label: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)
definition: Direct costs attributable to production of goods sold or services provided

label: Gross Profit
definition: Revenue minus cost of goods sold before deducting operating overhead

label: Operating Expenses (OPEX)
definition: Expenditures incurred in day-to-day operations outside of cost of goods sold

label: Selling, General, and Administrative (SG&A)
definition: Direct and indirect selling expenses and general administration costs

label: Employee Benefit Expenses / Staff Costs
definition: Salaries, wages, bonuses, pensions, and stock-based compensation

label: Research and Development (R&D) Expense
definition: Costs directed toward developing new products, processes, or IP

label: EBITDA
definition: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization

label: Depreciation Expense
definition: Gradual reduction in recorded value of tangible fixed assets

label: Amortization Expense
definition: Gradual reduction in recorded value of intangible assets over useful life

label: EBIT / Operating Profit
definition: Earnings before interest and taxes; operating profit from business activities

label: Finance Costs / Interest Expense
definition: Costs incurred in borrowing funds, including loan interest and debt servicing

label: Profit Before Tax (PBT)
definition: Net profit earned prior to deduction of corporate income tax expense

label: Tax Expense / Provision for Tax
definition: Current and deferred income tax expense charged against profit

label: Profit After Tax (PAT) / Net Income
definition: Total net earnings or profit remaining after all expenses, interest, and taxes

label: Basic Earnings Per Share (EPS)
definition: Net income divided by weighted average number of common shares outstanding

label: Diluted Earnings Per Share (EPS)
definition: Net income per share adjusted for all convertible securities and options

label: Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position
definition: Snapshot of company assets, liabilities, and equity at a specific point in time

label: Total Assets
definition: Total economic resources owned and controlled by the company

label: Total Current Assets
definition: Assets expected to be converted to cash, sold, or consumed within one year

label: Cash and Cash Equivalents
definition: Currency, bank deposits, and highly liquid short-term investments

label: Trade Receivables / Accounts Receivable
definition: Amounts owed to the business by customers for goods/services delivered on credit

label: Inventories / Stock-in-Trade
definition: Raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods held for sale

label: Prepaid Expenses & Other Current Assets
definition: Payments made in advance for goods or services to be received in the future

label: Total Non-Current / Fixed Assets
definition: Long-term assets with economic life greater than one year

label: Property, Plant, and Equipment (PP&E)
definition: Tangible long-lived assets utilized in operations (buildings, machinery, land)

label: Intangible Assets & Goodwill
definition: Non-physical assets including patents, trademarks, software, and acquired goodwill

label: Non-Current Investments
definition: Long-term securities, bonds, equity investments held in subsidiaries or associates

label: Total Liabilities
definition: Total financial debts, obligations, and claims against assets by non-owners

label: Total Current Liabilities
definition: Debts and obligations due to be settled within one year

label: Trade Payables / Accounts Payable
definition: Short-term debt obligations to suppliers and vendors for goods received on credit

label: Short-Term Borrowings / Debt
definition: Bank overdrafts, commercial paper, and short-term debt due within one year

label: Current Provisions
definition: Liabilities of uncertain timing or amount expected to be settled within one year

label: Total Non-Current / Long-Term Liabilities
definition: Obligations and debts payable beyond one year

label: Long-Term Borrowings / Debt
definition: Bonds, debentures, term loans payable beyond one year

label: Lease Liabilities
definition: Present value of future operating and financial lease obligations under IFRS 16 / ASC 842

label: Total Debt
definition: Sum of short-term and long-term interest-bearing borrowings

label: Total Shareholder's Equity
definition: Residual interest in the assets of the entity after deducting all liabilities

label: Share Capital / Common Stock
definition: Par value of shares issued to and held by shareholders

label: Retained Earnings / Reserves & Surplus
definition: Cumulative net profits retained in the business rather than distributed as dividends

label: Statement of Cash Flows
definition: Financial statement summarizing the amount of cash and cash equivalents entering and leaving

label: Cash Flow from Operating Activities (CFO)
definition: Cash generated or consumed by regular operational activities and working capital

label: Cash Flow from Investing Activities (CFI)
definition: Cash spent on or generated from investments in PP&E, M&A, and financial assets

label: Capital Expenditures (CapEx)
definition: Funds used by a company to acquire, upgrade, and maintain physical assets

label: Cash Flow from Financing Activities (CFF)
definition: Net flows of cash used to fund the company, including equity, debt, and dividends

label: Free Cash Flow (FCF)
definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures

label: Compliance and Governance
definition: Regulatory, statutory filings, audit and identity documents

label: Commercial Invoice
definition: Commercial document issued by seller to buyer indicating products, quantities, and prices

label: Tax Invoice
definition: Invoice containing prescribed tax details (e.g. GSTIN, VAT reg, HSN code, tax rate breakdown)

label: Electronic Invoice (e-Invoice / IRN)
definition: Standardized electronic invoice authenticated on government portal with QR/IRN

label: Credit Note
definition: Document issued by seller to buyer crediting invoice amounts for returns or discounts

label: Debit Note
definition: Document notifying buyer of a debit made to their account or requesting credit note

label: Statutory Filing / Return
definition: Formal submission of regulatory or financial documents to government authority

label: GST Return (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9)
definition: Periodic filing disclosing sales, purchases, and tax collected/paid under GST

label: VAT Return
definition: Periodic statement submitted by VAT-registered business to tax administration

label: SEC Form 10-K
definition: Comprehensive annual report of financial performance required by the US SEC

label: SEC Form 10-Q
definition: Quarterly financial report required by the US SEC

label: Auditor's Report
definition: Formal written opinion issued by an independent auditor regarding financial statements

label: Directors' Report / MD&A
definition: Statutory report produced by board of directors discussing operations and performance

label: Know Your Customer (KYC)
definition: Mandatory process of identifying and verifying the identity of clients/vendors

label: Tax Identification Number (TIN / PAN / GSTIN / EIN)
definition: Unique identifier issued by government authority for taxation and tracking purposes

label: Regulatory Penalty & Late Fee
definition: Financial penalty imposed for statutory non-compliance, late filing, or shortfall

label: Related Party Disclosures
definition: Statutory disclosure of transactions between reporting entity and affiliated parties

label: Contingent Liabilities
definition: Potential future liability that may occur depending on outcome of an uncertain event

label: Dividend Distribution Tax (DDT)
definition: Tax levied on dividends declared, distributed or paid by corporations

label: Digital Services Tax / Equalisation Levy
definition: Tax levied on digital advertising and e-commerce services from non-resident entities

label: Wealth & Net Worth Tax
definition: Direct tax levied on aggregate personal or corporate net wealth

label: Carbon Emission Tax & CBAM
definition: Environmental levy on greenhouse gas emissions and carbon-intensive imports

label: Real Estate & Municipal Property Tax
definition: Annual municipal tax levied on immovable property and land ownership

label: Mineral Oil & Fuel Excise Duty
definition: Specific excise duty levied on hydrocarbon fuels and energy products

label: Customs Tariff Valuation
definition: Ad valorem and specific customs duty assessment on imported merchandise

label: Anti-Dumping & Countervailing Duty
definition: Protective tariff imposed on foreign imports priced below fair market value

label: Safe Harbour Tax Provisions
definition: Statutory transfer pricing terms accepted by tax authorities without audit

label: Global Minimum Tax (Pillar Two GloBE)
definition: 15 percent global minimum corporate tax under OECD BEPS framework

label: Advance Pricing Agreement (APA)
definition: Formal agreement between taxpayer and tax authority determining transfer pricing methodology

label: Statutory Tax Audit (Section 44AB)
definition: Mandatory audit of accounts required by tax statutes when turnover exceeds threshold

label: Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT / CESTAT)
definition: Quasi-judicial appellate body adjudicating statutory tax disputes

label: Authority for Advance Rulings (AAR)
definition: Binding determination on prospective tax liabilities of non-residents and cross-border transactions

label: Penalty for Underreporting of Income
definition: Statutory fine levied for misreporting, concealment or aggressive tax avoidance

label: Tax on Foreign Remittances (TCS / Form 15CA)
definition: Statutory tax collection at source on outbound foreign currency remittances

label: Import VAT Reverse Charge Mechanism
definition: Postponed accounting for VAT on cross-border services and goods

label: Education & Health Cess / Surcharge
definition: Earmarked surcharge added to basic corporate and individual income tax liabilities

label: Statement of Comprehensive Income
definition: Financial statement summarizing net profit alongside other comprehensive income items

label: Other Comprehensive Income (OCI)
definition: Revenues, expenses, gains, and losses excluded from net income under US GAAP / IFRS

label: Revaluation Surplus Reserve
definition: Equity reserve reflecting upward valuation adjustments of property, plant, and equipment

label: Foreign Currency Translation Reserve
definition: Cumulative exchange differences arising on translation of foreign operations into presentation currency

label: Cash Flow Hedge Reserve
definition: Component of equity reflecting effective portion of gain or loss on hedging instruments

label: Defined Benefit Pension Plan Actuarial Reserve
definition: Remeasurements of net defined benefit liabilities recognized directly in equity

label: Non-Controlling / Minority Interest
definition: Portion of equity in a subsidiary not attributable directly or indirectly to the parent

label: Share Premium / Additional Paid-in Capital
definition: Amount received by a corporation in excess of the par value of its shares

label: Treasury Stock / Shares
definition: Company's own repurchased shares held in treasury, recorded as equity deduction

label: Share-Based Payment / ESOP Reserve
definition: Equity reserve reflecting fair value of employee stock options and share grants recognized over vesting

label: General / Statutory Reserve
definition: Accumulated portion of earnings retained under statute for future contingencies

label: Capital Work-in-Progress (CWIP)
definition: Expenditure incurred on assets under construction and plant erection before commissioning

label: Investment Property
definition: Real estate property held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation rather than operations

label: Biological Assets
definition: Living animals or plants managed under agricultural activity (IAS 41)

label: Right-of-Use (ROU) Assets
definition: Lessee asset representing right to use an underlying asset over lease term (IFRS 16)

label: Lease Liabilities - Current Portion
definition: Obligation to make lease payments due within 12 months (IFRS 16)

label: Lease Liabilities - Non-Current Portion
definition: Obligation to make lease payments falling due after 12 months

label: Deferred Revenue / Current Contract Liabilities
definition: Cash received for goods or services to be delivered within 12 months (ASC 606)

label: Non-Current Contract Liabilities
definition: Advance consideration received for deliverables extending beyond one fiscal year

label: Provisions for Employee Benefits
definition: Accrued statutory liabilities for employee gratuity, leave encashment, and severance

label: Warranty & Claims Provisions
definition: Estimated obligation to repair or replace sold products under statutory or contractual warranties

label: Restructuring Provisions
definition: Constructive liability arising from formal plan to terminate or reorganize lines of business

label: Asset Retirement & Decommissioning Obligation
definition: Legal obligation associated with the retirement and site restoration of tangible long-lived assets

label: Commercial Paper Outstanding
definition: Unsecured short-term promissory debt instrument issued by corporations to finance working capital

label: Subordinated & Mezzanine Debt
definition: Unsecured loans ranking below senior creditors with respect to claims on assets or earnings

label: Redeemable Preference Shares
definition: Class of share capital carrying preferential rights to dividends and capital return over equity

label: Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Allowance
definition: Contra-asset allowance measuring forward-looking default probabilities on trade receivables

label: iXBRL / XBRL Instance Filing
definition: Machine-readable financial disclosure tagged under statutory XBRL taxonomies

label: Certified Board Resolution
definition: Official formal document recording actions and decisions authorized by corporate board

label: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)
definition: Bilateral or multilateral agreement expressing convergence of will between commercial parties

label: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
definition: Legally binding confidentiality contract protecting proprietary financial data

label: Power of Attorney (POA)
definition: Statutory authorization empowering an agent to act on behalf of the corporation in tax filings

label: GSTIN / VAT Registration Certificate
definition: Statutory certificate issued by tax department evidencing consumption tax registration

label: Letter of Undertaking (LUT)
definition: Declaration filed by exporter committing to export goods without paying integrated consumption tax

label: Electronic Way Bill (e-Way Bill)
definition: Digital consignment note mandated for physical movement of goods above statutory invoice value

label: Customs Shipping Bill of Export
definition: Statutory customs declaration filed by exporter describing outbound cargo and foreign port

label: Customs Bill of Entry
definition: Statutory customs declaration submitted by importer for assessment and clearance of goods
